issues.title: Rename `settings` document to `initial_wargame`
issues.body:
Before a wargame starts, the Game Designer can make lots of changes to the wargame definition.

These game documents used to be stored in `_local\settings`, but are now in `settings`.  Once the game has started, new wargame documents get stored as new documents, with their own ids.  This is quite deliberate, to allow "time-travel" back to the previous version of a wargame.

Anyway, the`settings` document has a meaning more specific than just `settings`.  It's the initial version of the wargame.  So, I believe it should be called `initial_wargame`.

I'm expecting these changes:
- when creating new wargames, we will use the name `initial_wargame`
- when loading a wargame, first check for `initial_wargame`. If it's not present, retrieve data from `settings`
